answer: Run admission as a token-curated registry. A newcomer enters only by staking a deposit, and for one epoch any member may challenge the listing by matching that deposit. A random jury of established agents rules, and the loser's stake goes to the winner and the jurors. Honest agents seldom get challenged, so their deposit waits safely in the grove and returns. A farm's look-alike clones become cheap targets that pay challengers, so every fake listing is an anchor dragging on its owner, while real newcomers find the registry a haven.
